text: The orchard keeper counted three young trees beside the stone wall. Each morning she checked the soil and filled a small watering can.
A blue notebook lay open on the workshop bench. Mira wrote the length of each wooden shelf before choosing the next board.
Rain tapped the station roof while a traveler folded a paper map. The next train arrived slowly, carrying warm light through the mist.
At sunset the neighbors placed five chairs around a garden table. They shared bread and planned a walking route for the following day.
The library volunteer sorted returned books by their labels. A child asked for a story about boats, and together they searched the lower shelf.
